dataset: Daily and Sports Activities Data Set (DSADS)
record_used: subject p1, 19 activities; right-arm and left-arm accelerometer units @ 25 Hz
acquisition: 5 IMUs (torso, right arm, left arm, right leg, left leg), acc in m/s^2 -> g; 19 daily/sports activities x 60 five-second segments per subject
note: Healthy subject: both arms are used, so the reference is SYMMETRIC use (ratio ~1). The clinical application -- the affected/unaffected use ratio and the capacity-performance gap in stroke -- needs bilateral-wrist clinical data (e.g. NICHD DASH), which is DUA-gated, not freely public.
